description: PostgreSQL 18 range and multirange exclusion enforcement plus GiST/SP-GiST index and catalog behavior
sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_range_exclusion_keys (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, code text, span int4range);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_range_exclusion_keys ADD CONSTRAINT type_matrix_range_exclusion_keys_equal EXCLUDE USING gist (code WITH =, span WITH =);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_range_exclusion_keys VALUES (1, 'a', '[1,3)'), (2, 'a', '[2,4)');
INSERT INTO type_matrix_range_exclusion_keys VALUES (3, 'a', '[1,3)');
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_range_exclusion (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, account bigint NOT NULL, i4 int4range, i8 int8range, nr numrange, dr daterange, tr tsrange, tzr tstzrange, i4m int4multirange);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_i4_gist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING gist (i4);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_i8_spgist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING spgist (i8);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_nr_gist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING gist (nr);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_dr_spgist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING spgist (dr);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_tr_gist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING gist (tr);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_tzr_spgist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING spgist (tzr);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_i4m_gist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING gist (i4m);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_range_exclusion ADD CONSTRAINT type_matrix_range_exclusion_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (account WITH =, i4m WITH &&) WHERE (i4m IS NOT NULL);

SELECT c.conindid = i.indexrelid AS same_index, i.indisexclusion, am.amname FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = c.conindid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid = ic.relam WHERE c.conname = 'type_matrix_range_exclusion_no_overlap';

SELECT ic.relname::text, am.amname::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_class ic JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON am.oid = ic.relam WHERE ic.relname IN ('type_matrix_range_exclusion_i4_gist', 'type_matrix_range_exclusion_i8_spgist', 'type_matrix_range_exclusion_i4m_gist') ORDER BY ic.relname;
DROP INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_no_overlap;
INSERT INTO type_matrix_range_exclusion (id, account, i4m) VALUES (3, 7, '{[2,4)}');
INSERT INTO type_matrix_range_exclusion (id, account, i4m) VALUES (4, 8, '{[2,4)}');
UPDATE type_matrix_range_exclusion SET account = 7 WHERE id = 4;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_range_adjacency (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, exact_start numeric NOT NULL, exact_end numeric NOT NULL);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_range_adjacency ADD CONSTRAINT type_matrix_range_adjacency_not_adjacent EXCLUDE USING gist (numrange(exact_start, exact_end) WITH -|-);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_range_adjacency VALUES (1, 0.0000001, 0.0000002);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_range_adjacency VALUES (2, 0.0000002, 0.0000003);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_range_adjacency VALUES (3, 0.00000015, 0.00000025);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_range_exclusion_i4m_spgist ON type_matrix_range_exclusion USING spgist (i4m);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_range_exclusion ADD CONSTRAINT type_matrix_range_exclusion_spgist_multi EXCLUDE USING spgist (account WITH =, i4 WITH &&);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_range_exclusion ADD CONSTRAINT type_matrix_range_exclusion_noncommutative EXCLUDE USING gist (i4 WITH @>);
